note: Family-owned RV park built in 2020, half a mile from I-35 at Decatur City in southern Iowa, on open rolling farmland. Indoor common area with a big-screen TV (rents for groups), playground, two restaurants within walking distance. Two dogs at most per site; no generators. --Claude
